title: Binance Will List Gala (GALA)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Gala (GALA)  and will open trading for  GALA/BTC ,  GALA/BNB ,  GALA/BUSD , and  GALA/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-09-13 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  GALA  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for GALA will open at 2021-09-14 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Gala (GALA)? Gala is a gaming and NFT platform that aims to build an ecosystem of blockchain games. GALA is the platform utility token, and is used for node operator incentives, network governance, in-game rewards for playing platform games, in-game currency to purchase items and NFTs in the Gala store.
